about.title: About
sections: I am an aspiring software engineer with a strong interest in web development, artificial intelligence, and data-driven solutions. I enjoy building applications that solve real-world problems.
With hands-on experience in Python, JavaScript, and frontend technologies, I have developed multiple projects including e-commerce platforms and learning systems.
I am continuously learning through internships, certifications, and projects, and I am passionate about improving my technical and problem-solving skills.
